t: This is Belsize Road, which runs west to east from Kilburn High Road to close to Finchley Road, in the Swiss Cottage area. Despite the name, it lies west of Belsize Park, in South Hampstead. It is part of the B509 and runs largely alongside the Midland Main Line, with Kilburn High Road station at its eastern end. It meets Loudoun Road, Abbey Road and Priory Road. Thomas Cotterell, who lived from 1939 to 2019, lived here.
